relations.name: Funds and prioritises
relations.description: Finance leadership funds the finance-systems portfolio and expects Transformation Program returns.

relations.name: Sets standards for
relations.description: Technology leadership sets mandatory architecture standards that brand finance engineering follows.

relations.name: Feeds brand transactions to
relations.description: Brand systems send bookings and cancellations that the controller closes on.

relations.name: Delivers payment and settlement data to
relations.description: Payments provides captured payments, fees and PSP settlements for revenue and cash accounting.

relations.name: Funds partner payouts for
relations.description: Merchant-collected traveler funds are the source of partner payouts.

relations.name: Draws on liquidity from
relations.description: Payout runs depend on treasury funding the right accounts in the right currencies.

relations.name: Provides tax and FX positions to
relations.description: Tax provisions, indirect tax records and FX revaluation feed the close.

relations.name: Posts payables and accruals to
relations.description: Supplier invoices and accruals flow into the ledger for the close.

relations.name: Reports results to
relations.description: The controller delivers the closed, consolidated numbers leadership steers on.

relations.name: Assures controls for
relations.description: The SOX lead tests and evidences the close and reporting controls.

relations.name: Sets control requirements for
relations.description: Control requirements become part of architecture standards and decision reviews.

relations.name: Raises settlement exceptions with
relations.description: Payout and collection exceptions caused by payment data are routed back to payments.

relations.name: Sets savings targets for
relations.description: Leadership sets procurement optimization targets under the Transformation Program.
